scientific_findings: OMISSION_RECALL_RECORD: Boundary discontinuity margin loss pushed Omission Recall to 52.92% on replication and 59.81% on search, proving that acoustic edge penalties force the network to catch transient unreleased omissions.

SMOOTHNESS_TRADEOFF: Enforcing uniform temporal smoothness within phone slots penalizes legitimate diphthong glide transitions (/AY/, /AW/), blunting substitution precision. HRTD-Net's unconstrained local Gaussian attention remains the superior champion.
